```lean
import Algebra.Char
import Data.Fintype
import FieldTheory.RootOfUnity
import GroupTheory.Subgroup
import LinearAlgebra.Module
import RingTheory.Ring

open Fintype

theorem lg_target (M : Type u_1) (R : Type u_2) [CommMonoid M] [CommRing R] [Finite M] [HasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ)] : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ := by
  let n := Monoid.exponent Mˣ
  have h_root_of_unity : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n R) = n := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.natCard_rootsOfUnity M n
  let g : Mˣ := Subgroup.gen Mˣ
  have hg : ∀ x : Mˣ, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g := Subgroup.gen_mem_zpowers Mˣ g
  let ζ : Rˣ := MulChar.ofRootOfUnity_spec M R h_root_of_unity hg g

  -- Show that the map from Mˣ to Rˣ is a group homomorphism
  let f : Mˣ →* Rˣ := fun (a : Mˣ) => ↑ζ

  -- The set of multiplicative characters is in bijection with the set of group homomorphisms from Mˣ to Rˣ
  have h_char_bijection : MulChar M R ≃ₐ (Mˣ →* Rˣ) := MulChar.equivHom

  -- Use the fact that for finite abelian groups, the number of homomorphisms from G to Rˣ is equal to the cardinality of G
  have h_hom_card_eq : Nat.card (Mˣ →* Rˣ) = Nat.card Mˣ := by
    let G := Mˣ
    let H := G →* Rˣ
    let card_H : Nat.card H = Nat.card G :=
      by
        let f : G →* Rˣ := fun (g : G) => ↑ζ
        let h : G →* Rˣ := fun (g : G) => ↑ζ
        let H := { f | f : G →* Rˣ }
        have h_finite : Finite H := by
          rw [Finite.def]
          exact ⟨Nat.card H, _⟩
        have h_inj : InjOn (fun (f : H) => f g) H :=
          by intro f₁ f₂ hfg
          cases f₁ with f₁
          cases f₂ with f₂
          congr
          apply hfg
        have h_surj : SurjOn (fun (f : H) => f g) H :=
          by intro y
          let f : G →* Rˣ := fun (x : G) => if x = g then y else 1
          exact f
        exact Nat.card_inj h_inj h_surj
    exact card_H

  -- Conclude by transitivity
  exact h_char_bijection.symm.trans h_hom_card_eq
```
